newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Romania's President Emil Constantinescu met defence ministry officials to discuss the situation of the Romanian army.
* President Constantinescu has invited the leaders of opposition parties for talks this evening. Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) leader, ex-president Ion Iliescu, to attend.
* The economy and privatisation commission of the lower Chamber of Deputies analyses the 1997 draft state budget.
* Finance Minister Mircea Ciumara presented the budget draft at his National Peasant Party leading board session.

* The amount of 2.7 percent of the gross domestic product for health in 1997 is extremely small, said the members of the finance and budget commission in the upper house. The commission will propose a rise to 4.0 percent of GDP.

* Transport Minister Traian Basescu told the lower chamber's commission for industry that the 1.8 trillion lei in state budget money allotted for transport in 1997 is "extremely unsatisfactory, but the existing resources don't allow a rise."
* Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis is expected to arrive this afternoon in Bucharest for a two-day official visit. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
